# Drift Buoy DB-9

The Drift Buoy DB-9 is a floating buoy that logs water temperature, salinity
and wave height. It is made by [[castellan-marine]] and stored at
[[brask-station]] between deployments.

## Calibration

The buoy's sensors are calibrated every three months in a reference tank.
